subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into four parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

The sun / revolves / around / a earth.
solution:
The correct answer is: **a earth**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error is in the use of the article "**a**" before "earth."
 
• Indefinite article '**A**' is used when referring to a non-specific item or an item for the first time.
 
 
• **Example**: *I saw a cat in the backyard.*
 
 
 
• Definite Article "**the**" is used when referring to a specific item that has already been mentioned or is known to both the speaker and the listener.
 
 
• **Example**: *I saw the cat in the backyard again.*
 
 
 
• When referring to our planet, "**earth**" should be preceded by the definite article "**the**" rather than the indefinite article "**a**."
 
• The definite article "**the**" is used to specify a particular item, in this case, **the Earth around** which the sun revolves.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
